verdict.rationale: Featurebase is a feedback and roadmap product, so quick navigation to items by short name is a fair axis. The evidence pack never documents short IDs or a jump-to-item command for feedback, tasks, or initiatives. The customer-facing AI search bar and the posts-listing API are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump directly to any feedback item, task, or initiative by typing its short name
